brief:
Israeli forces killed 19 Palestinians over three days of attacks in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The strikes targeted a university and police and security personnel in Khan Younis, among other sites.

The latest violence adds to the toll of ongoing Israeli military operations in the territory. Details of the specific locations and circumstances of the deaths remained under investigation.
